🎓 How to Use the Customer Engagement Skill

Generate complete persona profiles with messaging and content recommendations.

💬

Trigger Phrases

  • "Build a persona for..."
  • "What does a CIO care about?"
  • "Buyer profile for..."
  • "Content strategy for..."
📝

Sample Prompt

"Build a buyer persona for a CIO at an enterprise manufacturing company evaluating cloud ERP. Include pain points, motivations, and content preferences."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Complete Profile — Demographics, psychographics
  • Journey Map — Awareness to decision
  • Content Plan — What to create for each stage
  • Objections — Common concerns & responses
💡

Pro Tips

  • Include industry — Persona varies by vertical
  • Specify company size — Enterprise vs SMB differ
  • Ask for objections — "What would make them say no?"
